jobs.title: Head of Corporate Clients
jobs.description: We are looking for a commercially minded and relationship-driven leader to help lead the next phase of growth of our corporate client business. This is an opportunity to take on an important leadership role with meaningful impact, combining business development, client leadership and the opportunity to shape how a regulated digital asset banking platform serves a fast-evolving market. As Head of Corporate Clients, you will work with leading digital asset companies and help deepen Sygnum’s position as a trusted partner for corporate clients. You will lead a high-performing team, build trusted client relationships and contribute to the continued growth of a business at the intersection of banking and digital assets. Your main responsibilities: - Own and grow Sygnum’s corporate client business across key client segments, and help shape our market positioning across the digital asset ecosystem, including crypto foundations, DLT projects and other crypto-native institutions - Lead, mentor and scale a high-performing corporate client team across sales, client coverage and solutions - Develop and execute the corporate client strategy in close partnership with the Chief Clients Officer - Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across key clients and prospects in Switzerland and across Sygnum’s international footprint - Work closely with Asset Management, custody, lending and trading teams to deliver the best possible solutions for corporate clients - Ensure alignment with FINMA requirements and Sygnum’s risk and compliance framework, while championing a trusted and well-governed approach to digital asset banking - Represent Sygnum at relevant industry forums, conferences and regulatory engagements in the digital asset space - Lead and further strengthen the client onboarding process in close collaboration with internal stakeholders, including Compliance and Operations - Use AI-enabled insights, such as client intelligence and pipeline analytics, to prioritise outreach, improve coverage quality and scale personalised client engagement - Stay close to market, product and regulatory developments, and build a strong network across the digital asset ecosystem - 10+ years of experience in corporate banking, ideally gained within a Swiss-regulated bank or a major international financial institution - A strong track record of building and managing corporate client relationships with measurable commercial impact. Previous people leadership experience with Relationship Managers and Assistant Relationship Managers would be an advantage - Strong understanding of digital assets and blockchain, or the curiosity and drive to build this expertise quickly - An established network and strong relationships across the digital assets ecosystem would be a strong advantage - Solid familiarity with Swiss banking regulation, including FINMA requirements and AML/KYC standards relevant to corporate client relationships - Strong interpersonal credibility and the ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders across crypto-native organisations - Comfortable using AI and data-driven insights to support client development, research and decision-making - An entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-growing, innovation-led environment - Fluency in English is essential; German and/or French would be an advantage. Sygnum offers a comprehensive package of benefits for all team members. They include: - Attractive combination of market salaries and entrepreneurial incentive scheme - Flexible/Work-At-Home policies - Professional development via Mentoring and Buddy programs - One-month fully paid sabbatical after five years of continuous employment This role offers the opportunity to contribute to one of the most established regulated platforms in digital assets, working with sophisticated clients at the intersection of traditional finance and the digital asset economy. Joining Sygnum means being part of a dynamic, global team that is building a trusted gateway between the traditional and digital asset economies. Working at Sygnum, you will experience our fast-paced, exciting work environment that embraces meritocracy and collaboration and open communication. Alongside our ambitious long-term mission, we also come together for reaching important milestones and annual crypto-industry anniversaries like Bitcoin Pizza Day and regularly celebrate together at themed company events as part of our journey to shape Future Finance. If you are passionate about the potential of blockchain to shape Future Finance and your profile is a good fit for this position, please send us your CV today!

descriptionByLocale.it: Siamo alla ricerca di un leader di mentalità commerciale e di rapporto-driven per aiutare a guidare la prossima fase di crescita del nostro business cliente aziendale. Questa è un'opportunità per assumere un ruolo di leadership importante con un impatto significativo, combinando lo sviluppo aziendale, la leadership dei clienti e l'opportunità di plasmare come una piattaforma di asset banking digitale regolamentata serve un mercato in rapida evoluzione. Come responsabile dei clienti aziendali, lavorerai con le principali società di asset digitali e aiuterai ad approfondire la posizione di Sygnum come partner affidabile per i clienti aziendali. Condurrai un team altamente performante, costruirai relazioni con i clienti affidabili e contribuirai alla continua crescita di un business all'incrocio tra attività bancarie e digitali. Responsabilità dei clienti principali: - Promuovere e crescere il business dei clienti aziendali di Sygnum attraverso i segmenti dei clienti chiave, e contribuire a plasmare il nostro posizionamento di mercato attraverso l’ecosistema delle risorse digitali, tra cui le fondazioni criptologiche, i progetti DLT e le altre istituzioni cripto-native - Leader, mentore e scalare un team di clienti aziendale di alto rendimento attraverso le vendite, la copertura clienti e le soluzioni Esperienza di leadership delle persone precedenti con Relationship Manager e Assistant Relationship Managers sarebbe un vantaggio - Una forte comprensione dei beni digitali e blockchain, o la curiosità e la spinta a costruire rapidamente questa esperienza - Una rete consolidata e forti relazioni tra l'ecosistema dei beni digitali sarebbero un forte vantaggio - Solida familiarità con la regolamentazione bancaria svizzera, compresi i requisiti FINMA e gli standard AML/KYC rilevanti per le relazioni con i clienti aziendali - Forte credibilità interpersonale e la capacità di impegnarsi efficacemente con gli stakeholder senior attraverso le organizzazioni cripto-native - Confortevole utilizzo di AI e informazioni basate sui dati per supportare lo sviluppo dei clienti, la ricerca e il processo decisionale - Una mentalità imprenditoriale e la capacità di operare efficacemente in un ambiente in rapida crescita, orientato all'innovazione - la fluidità in inglese è essenziale; tedesco e/o francese sarebbe un vantaggio. Sygnum offre un pacchetto completo di vantaggi per tutti i membri del team. Essi includono: - Combinazione attraente di stipendi di mercato e di incentivazione imprenditoriale - Politiche flessibili/lavoro-a casa - Sviluppo professionale tramite programmi Mentoring e Buddy - Un mese completamente pagato sabbatico dopo cinque anni di lavoro continuo Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di contribuire a una delle piattaforme regolamentate più stabilite nei beni digitali, lavorando con clienti sofisticati all'intersezione della finanza tradizionale e dell'economia di asset digitale. Unirsi a Sygnum significa essere parte di un team dinamico e globale che sta costruendo un gateway affidabile tra le economie di asset tradizionali e digitali. Lavorando a Sygnum, sperimenterete il nostro ambiente di lavoro veloce ed emozionante che abbraccia la meritocrazia e la collaborazione e la comunicazione aperta. Accanto alla nostra ambiziosa missione a lungo termine, ci uniamo anche per raggiungere importanti pietre miliari e anniversari cripto-industriali annuali come Bitcoin Pizza Day e celebrare regolarmente insieme a eventi aziendali a tema come parte del nostro viaggio per formare Future Finance. Se siete appassionati del potenziale di blockchain per modellare Future Finance e il vostro profilo è una buona misura per questa posizione, si prega di inviare il vostro CV oggi!

jobs.title: Head Digital Wealth
jobs.description:
We are looking for a commercially minded and client-centric leader to shape the next phase of growth of Sygnum's digital wealth business. This is an opportunity to take on a senior leadership role with meaningful impact, combining strategic, yet fully hands-on leadership, senior client engagement, business development and a strong instinct for emerging client needs and future offerings in a fast-evolving market. You will work at the intersection of traditional finance and digital assets, leading teams, building trusted relationships and helping position Sygnum as a trusted partner in the future of digital wealth. Your main responsibilities:
• Provide strategic leadership and further develop Sygnum's digital wealth business across private clients, External Asset Managers & Multi-Family Offices (EAMs & MFOs) and Sygnum Spark, strengthening growth, scalability and the long-term client service model
• Lead and manage the teams across relationship management and client servicing, with clear people leadership responsibility and ownership of the associated budget
• Define and implement the strategy for the digital wealth business in close alignment with the Group CEO and the Group Executive Board
• Own the performance of a substantial client portfolio with meaningful business volume and revenue contribution, while building and stewarding senior relationships across key wealth client segments, distribution partners and strategic ecosystem connections
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Asset Management, trading, custody, lending and other internal stakeholders to deliver differentiated investment, banking and digital wealth solutions for target client segments
• Shape the continued development and positioning of Sygnum's digital wealth offering, identifying evolving client needs and translating them into client propositions, commercial priorities and future growth opportunities
• Ensure the quality of the private client books with respect to financial and non-financial risk profiles, margins and client satisfaction, in line with regulatory requirements and Sygnum's risk and compliance framework
• Drive continuous improvement of onboarding, servicing and other key client processes together with Compliance, Operations and relevant business partners
• Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders and represent Sygnum credibly in the broader wealth, digital asset and strategic partner ecosystem
• Support the evolution of a modern, client-centric and scalable digital wealth platform that bridges traditional and digital finance
• Extensive leadership experience in wealth management, private clients, client solutions or a closely related financial services environment, including leading, developing and scaling high-performing client-facing teams and business areas
• Strong track record of building, growing and retaining client relationships and delivering commercial results across sophisticated wealth client segments, ideally in a leadership role with strategic business ownership
• Deep understanding of the needs of high-net-worth individuals, family offices, EAMs and related wealth client segments
• Strong understanding of wealth management products and client needs; familiarity with digital assets and a strong interest in the future of digital wealth are a clear advantage
• Strong compliance and risk management capabilities and experience operating in a regulated banking environment, including familiarity with Swiss banking regulation, AML/KYC requirements and cross-border considerations
• Excellent communication, presentation and representation skills, with the ability to engage credibly with senior clients and internal stakeholders
• Commercially minded, client-oriented and collaborative, with a strategic, yet fully hands-on approach, strong relationship leadership, sound judgement and the ability to build credibility across clients, partners and internal stakeholders
• Entrepreneurial and opportunity-oriented, with a strong feel for changing client expectations, market opportunities and the development of new propositions or partnerships
• Fluency in English and very good German are required; French is an advantage Joining Sygnum means being part of a dynamic, global team that is building a trusted gateway between the traditional and digital asset economies. Working at Sygnum, you will experience our fast-paced, exciting work environment that embraces meritocracy and collaboration and open communication. • Attractive combination of market salaries and entrepreneurial incentive scheme
• Flexible/Work at home policies
• Professional development via Mentoring and Buddy programs
• One-month fully paid sabbatical after five years of continuous employment If you are passionate about the potential of blockchain to shape Future Finance and your profile is a good fit for this position, please send us your CV today!

We collaborate closely with Custody, Trading, Tokenization, and Banking Operations teams to ensure our applications are robust, secure, and cutting-edge. We believe a supportive and enjoyable work environment fosters collaboration, trust, and proactive problem-solving. Joining us means being part of a team that’s as committed to quality and user experience as it is to create a workplace you’ll love coming to every day. • Lead a team of software engineers to develop and own state-of-the-art solutions (front and back end).
• Constantly enhance quality and security of the applications.
• Collaborate with Design to improve our client centric products.
• Contribute to writing and reviewing high quality and secured code covered by tests.
• Work with SRE engineers and solution architects to improve the availability, resilience, and observability of the applications. From a managerial perspective, you will:
• Coach and mentor software engineers in the team.
• Improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the team.
• Partner with product managers and stakeholders to plan new features and improvements.
• Drive blameless retros and post-mortems that help the team learn from mistakes.
• Promote a psychologically safe space where everyone feels they can contribute and improve things.
• Fluency in JavaScript, TypeScript, React and Nestjs.
• Designing reusable and extendable components for multiple projects.
• Experience and references as a Frontend Engineer in complex setups.
• Understanding UI & UX to seek the best experience for the user

• experienced with legal and regulatory matters that touch the core business of a Swiss bank with international activities?

• able to balance multiple complex situations to deliver on time with a high level of integrity, sense of urgency and quality standards?
• interested in answering new and tricky legal questions that cannot be looked up in a book?
• an emphatic team player and able to work under pressure and independently?
• keen to work in a dynamic, fast-moving and interdisciplinary scale-up bank?

• Serve as main legal contact regarding data protection
• Function as subject matter expert on IT-, data and security related laws and regulations and in other legal matters of the bank

• Support new business concepts and put complex products and innovative business ideas on a solid legal framework
• Act as sparring partner to management and all departments to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and requirements
• Calculate and handle legal risks in business processes and decision making
• Structure new product or program functionalities from a legal perspective
• Advise on legal and regulatory requirements in the daily business
• Review and drafting of standardized as well as non-standardized agreements between the bank and clients as well as the bank and other third parties

• Monitor legal and regulatory developments and implement measures
• Support the Head Legal and General Counsel in various legal matters
• Support internal legal projects and trainings
• A law degree from a Swiss University (admittance to the bar and additional relevant education like an LL.M. is an asset)
• At least four years of practical experience in data protection in banking, in a law firm and/or in a consulting firm
• An interest in complex and new legal and regulatory issues
• A great team player and communicator with strong interpersonal skills, able to defend the legal stand toward project management and other internal stakeholders
• Conceptual thinker with strong analytical and technical skills as well as courage to provide clear guidance based on own assessments
• Problem-solving ability and mental flexibility to find pragmatic solutions supporting the business with innovative products and business concepts
• Spotting and connecting cross-divisional dots and good in thinking one step ahead

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to take full, end-to-end business ownership of Sygnum’s core digital platforms — our website and our marketing CRM — and to lead how we use AI to scale, optimise and continually improve them. Sitting within the Marketing and Communications team in Zurich, you will own the systems that power our client journeys and acquisition, working closely with technology, operations, legal and executive leadership to deliver high-quality, data-driven digital experiences. AI-first: AI-native candidates preferred. At a minimum, you must have hands-on experience using a range of AI tools in your daily work. Candidates who can clearly demonstrate practical, results-driven use of AI will be prioritised. In this role you will be expected to:
• Use AI platforms for research, drafting, analysis, reporting and everyday productivity
• Apply AI to enhance our CMS and CRM platforms — for content generation, SEO and generative-engine optimisation (GEO), metadata, image tagging, translation and brand-consistency checks
• Design and run agentic AI workflows that automate repetitive tasks across content production, publishing, audience segmentation and reporting
• Use AI to interrogate performance data, surface insight and produce clear, decision-ready reporting
• Continually evaluate emerging AI tools and embed the best of them into our digital operations to scale reach, quality and efficiency Key responsibilities: Digital Platforms – Website: You will have full, end-to-end business ownership of the Sygnum website:
• Manage day-to-day content updates, page builds and publishing across our CMS, ensuring accuracy, quality and brand consistency
• Design, build and optimise client journeys, leverage the CRM to manage lead nurturing and generate onboarding demand
• Leverage AI technologies to expand, enhance and scale next-generation web architecture
• Own feature development and the website roadmap — scoping requirements and coordinating delivery with technology teams and external partners
• Drive continual performance optimisation across site speed, UX, conversion, SEO/GEO and accessibility
• Own analytics, dashboards and regular reporting on traffic, engagement and conversion, turning data into clear recommendations
• Knowledge of website security protocols, cyber risk and Content Distribution Networks (CDNs)
• Work with the website product Manager, UX team and other internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless client experience and project delivery Digital Platforms – Marketing CRM & Email: You will own our marketing CRM and email programme end-to-end:
• Draft, format and manage email campaigns and automated user journeys from concept to delivery
• Take a holistic view of the client journey — from email through to website landing pages and into the sales funnel — ensuring CRM and website are fully integrated
• Build, segment and maintain audiences while upholding the highest standards of data security, privacy and compliance
• Use AI tools to continually optimise performance — personalisation, send-time optimisation, subject-line and content testing — and to expand reach
• Track, analyse and report on deliverability, engagement and conversion across the funnel
• Work with the CRM Product Manager, data and analytics team and other internal stakeholders to continually enhance the CRM’s feature set, usability and performance Integrated marketing & communications Highly valued is the ability to support broader, integrated communications, including:
• Physical events, webinars and livestreams, social media (paid and organic), digital advertising
• General marketing activities and the ability to support, pick up and deliver a diverse range of projects across the team
• Hands-on experience using a range of AI tools in daily work — AI-native strongly preferred
• Minimum 5–7 years’ experience owning and managing a multi-site corporate website, website Content Management Systems (CMS) and CRM/email marketing platform end-to-end in similar roles (essential)
• Highly structured, well-organised and methodical, with the ability to plan, prioritise and work in a disciplined way
• Strong analytical skills, experienced at reporting and making data driven decisions
• Excellent project management skills: able to organise, structure, plan and communicate complex projects, and deliver them on time and to a high standard
• High level stakeholder management skills, comfortable working across technology, operations, legal and executive leadership
• Experience working in a regulated financial environment — banks, financial institutions or fintechs — highly valued
• Open, energetic and team-oriented high performer, eager to contribute in a high-growth environment
• Fluent in English; German highly valued Joining Sygnum means being part of a dynamic, global team that is building a trusted gateway between the traditional and digital asset economies. Working at Sygnum, you will experience our fast-paced, exciting work environment that embraces meritocracy and collaboration and open communication. Alongside our ambitious long-term mission, we also come together for reaching important milestones and annual crypto-industry anniversaries like Bitcoin Pizza Day, and regularly celebrate together at themed company events as part of our journey to shape Future Finance. Sygnum offers a comprehensive package of benefits for all team members. They include:
• Attractive combination of market salaries and entrepreneurial incentive scheme
• Flexible/Work at home policies
• Professional development via Mentoring and Buddy programs
• One-month fully paid sabbatical after five years of continuous employment If you are passionate about the potential of blockchain to shape Future Finance and your profile is a good fit for this position, please send us your CV today!

• Attività di marketing generale e la capacità di supportare, raccogliere e fornire una vasta gamma di progetti in tutto il team
• Esperienza pratica utilizzando una gamma di strumenti AI nel lavoro quotidiano — AI-native fortemente preferito
• Esperienza minima da 5 a 7 anni di proprietà e gestione di un sito web aziendale multi-sito, sito Content Management Systems (CMS) e piattaforma di marketing CRM/email end-to-end in ruoli simili (essenziale)
• Altamente strutturato, ben organizzato e metodologico, con la capacità di pianificare, prioritizzare e lavorare in modo disciplinato
• Abilità analitiche forti, sperimentate nel reporting e nel prendere decisioni basate sui dati
• Eccellente capacitÃ di gestione del progetto: in grado di organizzare, strutturare, pianificare e comunicare progetti complessi, e consegnarli in tempo e ad alto livello
• Capacità di gestione degli stakeholder di alto livello, lavoro confortevole attraverso la tecnologia, operazioni, leadership legale e executive
• Esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente finanziario regolamentato — banche, istituzioni finanziarie o fintech — altamente apprezzata
• Esecutore alto aperto, energico e orientato al team, desideroso di contribuire in un ambiente ad alta crescita
• Fluente in inglese; il tedesco altamente apprezzato Joining Sygnum significa essere parte di un team dinamico e globale che sta costruendo un gateway affidabile tra le economie di asset tradizionali e digitali. jobs.description:
As part of the Compliance Framework, Governance, Assurance, Control and Reporting team, this role supports the ongoing development and effective maintenance of the Bank’s compliance and policy framework, ensuring alignment with regulatory developments and emerging best practices. The role is also responsible for coordinating audit-related activities, including audit inquiries, regulatory requests, and the timely remediation of findings. Furthermore, it contributes to the identification, assessment, and implementation of regulatory changes across the organization, supporting the continuous enhancement of the Bank’s compliance, governance, and control environment. Your main responsibilities:
• Manage and maintain the Bank’s policy and compliance framework, ensuring alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and internal governance standards.
• Monitor and assess regulatory developments and changes, ensuring timely analysis, interpretation and implementation across the organisation.
• Coordinate audit-related activities, including handling audit requests, supporting audit reviews, and ensuring timely remediation and closure of findings.
• Coordinate regulatory requests, ensuring completeness, accuracy and timely delivery of information.
• Drive the development and maintenance of compliance risk assessments, ensuring risks are properly identified, assessed, documented and mitigated.
• Manage and perform Internal Control System (ICS) activities, including controls design, testing and ongoing assurance of control effectiveness.
• Support in preparing and managing compliance reporting, including internal reporting and regulatory reporting obligations, ensuring consistency and reliability of reported information.
• Oversee compliance tool management, including the use of digital solutions and AI, to enhance efficiency, automation and overall effectiveness of compliance processes.
• A minimum of five years’ experience in Compliance, with a strong focus on compliance framework management, control assurance, audit coordination, and regulatory engagement, gained within a Swiss or EU financial institution or within audit and consulting functions serving the financial services sector.
• Sound knowledge of applicable regulatory requirements, including the Anti-Money Laundering Act (AMLA), Anti-Money Laundering Ordinance (AMLO), FINMA Anti-Money Laundering Ordinance (AMLO-FINMA), CDB 20, and relevant FINMA circulars, with particular expertise in governance, risk management, internal controls, and regulatory reporting.
• Experience in regulatory interactions, including the coordination of supervisory requests, preparation of regulatory submissions, and engagement with regulatory authorities.
• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to assess regulatory developments and translate them into practical, risk-based implementation measures across the organisation.
• Proven experience in the design, implementation, and testing of Internal Control Systems (ICS), including the development of control frameworks, execution of design and operating effectiveness testing, and ongoing assurance activities.
• Demonstrated expertise in compliance risk assessments, audit management, and the coordination of audit activities, including the handling of audit requests, remediation of findings, and timely closure of corrective actions.
• Experience leveraging compliance technologies and digital solutions, with a strong interest in utilising automation, data analytics, and artificial intelligence to enhance compliance processes, controls, and reporting capabilities.
• University degree in Law, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of relevant professional qualifications and experience.
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships across all levels of the organisation, including senior management, and confidently navigate complex and challenging discussions.
• A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset, capable of identifying control gaps, constructively challenging existing practices, and driving pragmatic, sustainable improvements.
• A collaborative team player with a positive and professional attitude, committed to fostering an inclusive, constructive, and high-performing work environment.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in German is considered a significant advantage. Joining Sygnum means being part of a dynamic, global team that is building a trusted gateway between the traditional and digital asset economies. Working at Sygnum, you will experience our fast-paced, exciting work environment that embraces meritocracy and collaboration and open communication. Alongside our ambitious long-term mission, we also come together for reaching important milestones and annual crypto-industry anniversaries like Bitcoin Pizza Day, and regularly celebrate together at themed company events as part of our journey to shape Future Finance. Sygnum offers a comprehensive package of benefits for all team members. They include:
• Attractive combination of market salaries and entrepreneurial incentive scheme
• Flexible/Work at home policies
• Professional development via Mentoring and Buddy programs
• One-month fully paid sabbatical after five years of continuous employment If you are passionate about the potential of blockchain to shape Future Finance and your profile is a good fit for this position, please send us your CV today!

Il ruolo è anche responsabile del coordinamento delle attività connesse all'audit, comprese le indagini di audit, le richieste di regolamentazione e la tempestiva bonifica dei risultati. Inoltre, contribuisce all’identificazione, alla valutazione e all’attuazione dei cambiamenti normativi in tutta l’organizzazione, sostenendo il continuo miglioramento della conformità, della governance e dell’ambiente di controllo della Banca. Le vostre principali responsabilità:
• Gestire e mantenere il quadro di politica e conformità della Banca, garantendo l’allineamento con i requisiti normativi applicabili e gli standard di governance interna.
• Monitorare e valutare gli sviluppi e le modifiche normative, garantendo analisi tempestive, interpretazione e implementazione in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Coordinate le attività connesse all'audit, incluse le richieste di audit, il supporto alle recensioni di audit e la tempestiva bonifica e chiusura dei risultati.
• Coordinare le richieste normative, garantire la completezza, l'accuratezza e la tempestiva consegna delle informazioni.
• Guida lo sviluppo e la manutenzione delle valutazioni dei rischi di conformità, assicurando che i rischi siano adeguatamente identificati, valutati, documentati e mitigati.
• Gestire ed eseguire attività del Sistema di Controllo Interno (ICS), tra cui la progettazione dei controlli, la prova e la garanzia in corso di efficacia del controllo.
• Sostegno nella preparazione e nella gestione delle relazioni di conformità, compresi gli obblighi di reporting interno e di reporting regolamentare, garantendo coerenza e affidabilità delle informazioni segnalate.
• Superare la gestione degli strumenti di conformità, compreso l'uso di soluzioni digitali e AI, per migliorare l'efficienza, l'automazione e l'efficacia complessiva dei processi di conformità.
• Un’esperienza minima di cinque anni in Compliance, con una forte attenzione alla gestione del quadro di conformità, all’assicurazione di controllo, al coordinamento dell’audit e all’impegno normativo, acquisita all’interno di un istituto finanziario svizzero o dell’UE o all’interno di funzioni di audit e consulenza che servono il settore dei servizi finanziari.
• Sonore conoscenze dei requisiti normativi applicabili, tra cui l'Anti-Money Laundering Act (AMLA), l'Ordinance Anti-Money Laundering (AMLO), la FINMA Anti-Money Laundering Ordinance (AMLO-FINMA), la CDB 20 e le relative circolari della FINMA, con particolare competenza nella governance, nella gestione dei rischi, nei controlli interni e nel reporting normativo.
• Esperienza nelle interazioni normative, tra cui il coordinamento delle richieste di supervisione, la preparazione delle presentazioni normative e l'impegno con le autorità di regolamentazione.
• Forte capacità di pensiero analitico e critico, con la capacità di valutare gli sviluppi normativi e di tradurli in misure pratiche di implementazione basate sui rischi in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Esperienza dimostrata nella progettazione, realizzazione e collaudo dei sistemi di controllo interno (ICS), tra cui lo sviluppo di quadri di controllo, l'esecuzione di test di progettazione e di efficacia operativa e le attività di garanzia in corso.
• Competenza dimostrata nella valutazione dei rischi di conformità, nella gestione dell'audit e nel coordinamento delle attività di audit, compresa la gestione delle richieste di audit, la bonifica dei risultati e la tempestiva chiusura delle azioni correttive.
• L'esperienza sfrutta le tecnologie di conformità e le soluzioni digitali, con un forte interesse nell'utilizzo dell'automazione, dell'analisi dei dati e dell'intelligenza artificiale per migliorare i processi di conformità, i controlli e le funzionalità di reporting.
• Laurea in Giurisprudenza, Finanza, Economia, Business Administration, o una disciplina correlata, o una combinazione equivalente di qualifiche professionali e di esperienza rilevanti.
• Forte capacità di gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di costruire relazioni di lavoro efficaci su tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione, tra cui la gestione senior, e navigare con fiducia discussioni complesse e stimolanti.
• Una mentalità proattiva e orientata alle soluzioni, capace di identificare le lacune di controllo, sfidare costruttivamente le pratiche esistenti e di portare miglioramenti pragmatici e sostenibili.
• Un team player collaborativo con un atteggiamento positivo e professionale, impegnato a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, costruttivo e performante.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale in inglese; la competenza in tedesco è considerato un vantaggio significativo. Unirsi a Sygnum significa essere parte di un team dinamico e globale che sta costruendo un gateway affidabile tra le economie di asset tradizionali e digitali. Lavorando a Sygnum, sperimenterete il nostro ambiente di lavoro veloce ed emozionante che abbraccia la meritocrazia e la collaborazione e la comunicazione aperta. Accanto alla nostra ambiziosa missione a lungo termine, ci uniamo anche per raggiungere importanti pietre miliari e anniversari cripto-industriali annuali come Bitcoin Pizza Day, e regolarmente celebrare insieme a eventi aziendali a tema come parte del nostro viaggio per formare Future Finance. Sygnum offre un pacchetto completo di vantaggi per tutti i membri del team. Essi includono:
• Combinazione attraente di salari di mercato e di incentivazione imprenditoriale
• Flessibile / Lavoro nelle politiche domestiche
• Sviluppo professionale tramite programmi Mentoring e Buddy
• Un mese completamente pagato sabbatico dopo cinque anni di lavoro continuo Se siete appassionati del potenziale di blockchain per modellare Future Finance e il vostro profilo è una buona misura per questa posizione, si prega di inviare il vostro CV oggi!

jobs.description:
We are looking for a seasoned Communications Manager with a broad skillset to support Sygnum’s external communications activities. Sitting within the Marketing and Communications team in Zurich, you will protect, grow and enhance Sygnum’s brand with external audiences and communities, working closely with stakeholders across the business including technology, operations, legal and executive leadership. AI-first: AI-native candidates preferred. At a minimum, you must have hands-on experience using a range of AI tools in your daily work. Candidates who can clearly demonstrate practical, results-driven use of AI will be prioritised. In this role you will be expected to:
• Use AI platforms for research, drafting press releases, pitches and briefing notes, analysis and reporting
• Use AI-powered media monitoring and intelligence platforms for coverage tracking, sentiment analysis and share-of-voice
• Apply AI within social media management tools for content drafting, scheduling, optimal send-time and performance analytics
• Use AI for social listening, competitor analysis and audience insight to inform strategy and continually optimise growth
• Continually evaluate emerging AI tools and embed the best of them into our communications workflows to scale reach, quality and efficiency The role: This is a broad external communications role with two areas of particular emphasis: public relations and strategic community management. Public relations: You will own external communications and media relations end-to-end:
• Manage the full announcement cycle — writing and distributing press releases, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, pitching the news and managing interviews
• Build and maintain strong relationships with key journalists, editors and media outlets
• Secure media commentary and thought-leadership opportunities, and news-jack relevant market narratives with Sygnum insight, research and market data
• Develop key messages, briefing notes and Q&A, and prepare spokespeople for interviews and media engagements
• Run media monitoring and coverage tracking, with sentiment analysis and share-of-voice
• Report on PR performance and analytics, translating coverage into clear insight and recommendations
• Manage external PR agencies and partners to deliver efficiently and to a high standard Community management: You will own the community social media strategy and growth, with a strong focus on LinkedIn:
• Lead the strategy for end-to-end social media management, from content planning and posting strategy through to drafting, scheduling and publishing
• Grow followers, engagement and reach on LinkedIn through a deliberate, data-led content and posting strategy
• Plan and manage paid social and promotional campaigns
• Conduct competitor analysis and benchmarking to identify opportunities
• Continually optimise performance using analytics to drive sustained growth Integrated marketing & communications: Highly valued is the ability to support broader, integrated communications, including:
• Physical events, webinars and livestreams, social media (paid and organic), digital advertising
• General marketing activities and the ability to support, pick up and deliver a diverse range of projects across the team
• Native-level German and fluent English — mandatory
• Open, energetic and team-oriented high performer, eager to contribute in a high-growth environment
• Hands-on experience using a range of AI tools in daily work — AI-native strongly preferred
• Experience in digital assets, fintech and traditional finance with knowledge of financial products in a regulated environment— essential
• Minimum 7–10 years’ experience in a dedicated communications role;
• Proven experience PR agency experience highly valued for workflow efficiency and industry contacts. Strong knowledge of the Swiss media landscape, key publications and journalists — highly prized
• Excellent written communication skills, with proven experience drafting press releases, articles, reports and presentations
• Highly adaptable, strong at prioritising, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
• Experience working cross-border with global teams Joining Sygnum means being part of a dynamic, global team that is building a trusted gateway between the traditional and digital asset economies. Working at Sygnum, you will experience our fast-paced, exciting work environment that embraces meritocracy and collaboration and open communication. Alongside our ambitious long-term mission, we also come together for reaching important milestones and annual crypto-industry anniversaries like Bitcoin Pizza Day, and regularly celebrate together at themed company events as part of our journey to shape Future Finance. Sygnum offers a comprehensive package of benefits for all team members. They include:
• Attractive combination of market salaries and entrepreneurial incentive scheme
• Flexible/Work at home policies
• Professional development via Mentoring and Buddy programs
• One-month fully paid sabbatical after five years of continuous employment If you are passionate about the potential of blockchain to shape Future Finance and your profile is a good fit for this position, please send us your CV today!

• Pianificare e gestire campagne promozionali e retribuite
• Condurre l'analisi dei concorrenti e il benchmarking per identificare le opportunità

• Attività di marketing generale e la capacità di supportare, raccogliere e fornire una vasta gamma di progetti in tutto il team
• Inglese tedesco e fluente di livello nativo — obbligatorio
• Esecutore alto aperto, energico e orientato al team, desideroso di contribuire in un ambiente ad alta crescita
• Esperienza pratica utilizzando una gamma di strumenti AI nel lavoro quotidiano — AI-native fortemente preferito
• Esperienza in asset digitali, fintech e finanza tradizionale con conoscenza dei prodotti finanziari in un ambiente regolamentato—essenziale
• Esperienza minima di 7-10 anni in un ruolo di comunicazione dedicato;
• Esperienza comprovata esperienza agenzia PR esperienza altamente apprezzata per l'efficienza del flusso di lavoro e contatti del settore. Forte conoscenza del panorama dei media svizzeri, delle pubblicazioni chiave e dei giornalisti — altamente apprezzati
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta, con comprovata esperienza di redazione comunicati stampa, articoli, report e presentazioni
• Altamente adattabile, forte a priori, e confortevole lavoro in un ambiente veloce e dinamico
• Unisciti a Sygnum significa essere parte di un team dinamico e globale che sta costruendo un gateway affidabile tra le economie di asset tradizionali e digitali. Lavorando a Sygnum, sperimenterete il nostro ambiente di lavoro veloce ed emozionante che abbraccia la meritocrazia e la collaborazione e la comunicazione aperta. Sygnum offre un pacchetto completo di vantaggi per tutti i membri del team. Essi includono:
• Combinazione attraente di salari di mercato e di incentivazione imprenditoriale
• Flessibile / Lavoro nelle politiche domestiche
• Sviluppo professionale tramite programmi Mentoring e Buddy
• Un mese completamente pagato sabbatico dopo cinque anni di lavoro continuo Se siete appassionati del potenziale di blockchain per modellare Future Finance e il vostro profilo è una buona misura per questa posizione, si prega di inviare il vostro CV oggi!

• Support the implementation and operational handling of new products and services
• Contribute to continuous quality improvement and risk management of our Financial Services Operations

• 5-7+ years of deep, hands-on experience in application security or DevSecOps in modern engineering environments .
• Strong experience securing cloud-native architectures (AWS and Azure preferred ) .
• Deep understanding of Kubernetes security, containers, and IaC security .
